# Jira Data Center Provider





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `base_url` (String) Base URL of the Jira Data Center instance, for example https://jira.example.com

### Optional

- `token` (String, Sensitive) Jira API token. Can be set via the `JIRA_TOKEN` environment variable.
- `username` (String) Jira username for Basic Auth. Can be set via the JIRA_USERNAME environment variable.
